metadata.name: 元
metadata.description: the origin cel. its v is the readme (plain lowercase text, owner-edited). one artifact, two audiences: humans read it expanded, agents pack it as context.

cels.v:
you are at the origin. everything here is a cel: a key plus a value,
maybe computed by a formula. type a formula in the box and press enter
- it becomes a new cel beside this one. click any cel to open or close
it. commit an empty box on an open cel to delete it - deleting a
formula unmakes everything it made.

try:
  =1+1
  =grid(3, 3)                   a small spreadsheet grid
  =grid(4, 2, "books")          a named one (cells books.A1..)
  =books!A1 & "!"               read another grid's cell
  =sum(books!A1:A4)             or a range of it
  =js(c1, "myfn")               turn source in c1 into myfn(...)
  =checkpoint("before-mess")    a snapshot you can restore
  =load("sheet")                load a library segment
  =cels("sheet")                list what a segment provides

errors never crash anything: a bad formula shows an error value in its
cel and the details land in the "errors" cel. every loaded segment
documents itself - read its skill before using it.

metadata.name: 元.mount
metadata.description: where the freespace view mounts. the host's one knob; null hides it.

metadata.name: 元.expanded
metadata.description: key of the currently open cel box (null = all closed).

metadata.name: freespace.index
metadata.description: ordered key list of the visible freespace cels (the view's idx input; commit maintains it alongside the vals array wiring).

metadata.name: 元.view
metadata.description: the freespace view. UNLOCKED on purpose - minimal, ready to be entirely reworked in place. origin.commit rewires its idx/vals inputMap arrays as cels are made.

cels.f: (originView readme expanded draft mount idx vals banner)

metadata.name: originView
metadata.description: (readme expanded draft mount idx vals) - freespace RenderSpec producer.

metadata.name: origin.commit
metadata.description: (state, targetKey) - the entry gesture: sniff =/(/literal, create cN in freespace (or edit/delete the open cel), rewire the view, cycle, drain all effect channels + paint.

metadata.name: origin.expand
metadata.description: (state, key) - toggle a cel box open/closed; seeds the draft with its source.

metadata.name: origin.key
metadata.description: (state, targetKey, event) - Enter commits the draft.

metadata.name: origin.noop
metadata.description: swallow clicks inside the entry box.

metadata.name: origin.effects
metadata.description: load/cels requests commit here (effects at drain).

metadata.name: origin.drain
metadata.description: (items) - execute load (ensureSegments) and cels (segment listing) requests; result text replaces the request as the cel's value.

metadata.name: load
metadata.description: (name) - load a library segment (lazy loaders + store). capability arrives silently; views are asked for.

metadata.name: cels
metadata.description: (segment) - readable listing of a segment's cels (skill first; locked marked).

metadata.name: readme
metadata.description: () - genesis vocabulary: make the readme a banner div above freespace (freespace.banner). delete the =readme() formula and the sweep removes the div.

metadata.name: readmeBanner
